subject: Media Literacy
title: Ad Blockers and the Arms Race
description: Learn Ad Blockers and the Arms Race in one minute.

hook.text: Over 40% of internet users now run ad blockers. Advertisers call it theft. Users call it self-defense.

buildup.text: Ad blockers remove advertisements from web pages, giving users faster, cleaner browsing experiences.

discovery.text: In response, websites block ad-blocker users or make them pay for ad-free access.

twist.text: Ad blockers may actually hurt small publishers most, while tech giants shift to unblockable ad formats.

climax.text: The ad-blocking arms race reveals a fundamental tension: free content requires advertising revenue.

punchline.text: Block the ads and the content might disappear too.

quiz.question: What is the core tension revealed by ad blockers?
options: Free content typically requires advertising revenue to exist
